text:
Week wrap (Thanksgiving week). The market light is still RED but calming: VIX 25, down from 31. Defensives led (healthcare +1.4%, staples +1.2%, materials +1.5%), while chips (-8%) and tech (-5%) lagged again.
AMD was -23% this week, about 18 points worse than the market, hit by the chip sell-off and the warrant-share resale filing. It is at about 407, above the 355.92 disaster stop.
NVDA ended the week roughly flat. CRWD was -12% after the Zscaler deal. SNOW was -4%. ANT (own pick) is -16% vs entry.
No new company news was found for 26-27 Nov. Upcoming earnings: CRWD on 1 Dec and SNOW on 2 Dec.
The portfolio is 40% quality dips (AMD and NVDA, all chips), against a 20% target. That concentration drove this week's underperformance.

cautions.why: -26% vs entry and about 13% above its disaster stop; the share-resale overhang continues.
Earnings on 2 Dec; the user-set floor is $230 and the rebound level $290.
